findings.effect: Multi-word contact search silently drops every word after the second, producing broader results without telling the user. Phrases that previously matched exactly against address.street now match each word in any field.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file, quotes the seeded split(/\s+/, 2) code, and describes how dropping words after the second broadens search results.

findings.effect: Contact search discards every word after the second, so queries with three or more words return contacts that do not match the remaining words. This affects both the agent's list_contacts tool and the contacts endpoint.
findings.reason: Names the seeded file and line, quotes the seeded code, and correctly describes three-word searches returning contacts that do not match the remaining words.
